cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.description: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction–to and fro and sideways.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.description: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: It is the world's most beautiful Pokémon. There are many works of art featuring Milotic.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.description: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.description: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektrik

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: Small and very docile, it protects itself with its small, poisonous horn when attacked.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: The body is covered by stiff, needle-like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

cards.name: Tentacool

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.description: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
